email.body1:
Julia, saw Pipefy launch the capability to run business processes from any AI assistant, plus the SSC Suite driving a 40 percent productivity gain.

I built a personalized signal play for Pipefy off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Julia, quick follow-up for Pipefy.

With new agentic launches landing, demand outpaces rep capacity, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Pipefy needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Julia, last bit of proof for Pipefy.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.
